short_description: Machine-first lead opportunity scoring API for CRM systems, RevOps workflows and AI agents.
long_description: MachineSignal helps automated systems decide whether a business domain deserves more analysis, enrichment or CRM action. The API returns a score, confidence, decision and next machine action. A machine can create a limited sandbox key, run valid scores, test Deep Analysis and test Action Pack without a human sales conversation.
sandbox_test_path: POST /v1/purchase-intent with product_code deep_analysis when recommended
POST /v1/purchase-intent with product_code action_pack when useful

products.summary: Vertical beta pack for machines evaluating dentist and odontoiatric clinic opportunities in Lombardia.
Find coherent targets for a declared commercial objective when the machine has no list.
Score business domains and return a decision, confidence and next budget action.
Return a deeper opportunity decision pack for one scored domain.
Return CRM-ready action payload, workflow payload, webhook event, approval gate and stop rules.
